text: Crafted Cooked Meat (tick 1495, '45 energy each'), but there is no way to eat it: no eat key on any of the 3 Controls pages, no button in the Inventory (I) screen, no HUD button. Energy 95 unchanged. Players cannot tell if/when food is consumed.

Cooked Meat vanished from inventory between tick ~2600 and 3247 with no message; energy went from ~90 to 99.2 (capped at 100). Auto-eat triggers below 90 energy and picks the MOST nourishing food first, so the 45-energy cooked meat restores only ~10 while 12 apples (15 each) sit in the bag. Crafting cooked meat is effectively wasted.

Planks and Bricks (2 of 5 recipes) stay locked even in my own founded settlement (tick ~7400): need Village era = 1 village, 10 members, 2 stalls, day 3. With game time at 0-17 tps on this machine, day 3 is far out of reach in a 30-min session; a player can't try trade-good crafting early. Lock reason is clearly shown in orange, which is good.
